The Ender Dragon is the fifth boss you will encounter in your journey
Lore of Ender Dragon, The ancient builder

"The Ender Dragon, affectionately nicknamed "Jean" by creator Notch, is widely theorized to be the tragic, final guardian of a civilization lost to time. The official lore, though sparse, suggests she is the last survivor of a species hunted by the "Ancient Builders," a highly advanced race of humans who eventually devolved into the Endermen we know today after fleeing a cataclysm in the Overworld. The obsidian pillars and the rejuvenating End Crystals are theorized to be the Builders' original life-support system for the dragon, designed to keep their ultimate security system alive indefinitely. Thus, the dragon is not simply a final boss, but a solitary protector, fiercely defending her empty dimension and the Dragon Egg—the last hope for the future of her species—from the very descendants of those who created her predicament..."
You can find the Ender Dragon in the end, near the spawn of the end portal.
